newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Foreign Stadshypotek owner not ruled out - FinMin.
newsitem.headline: Foreign Stadshypotek owner not ruled out - FinMin.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Tuesday he did not rule out foreign ownership of Sweden's largest mortgage bank, Stadshypotek.
"I see no decisive hindrances for foreign ownership in Stadshypotek. In some cases this can be positive for competition," Asbrink said at a seminar in Stockholm.
Bids for the state's 34 percent stake in Stadshypotek were due on Monday after the government announced 10 days ago that it intended to sell its holding for the highest price by a controlled auction.
A merger proposal announced last week by Stadshypotek and insurance company Skandia annoyed the usually reserved Swedish finance minister, who said he had not been consulted.
Asbrink said it was likely that he expected more foreign ownership in Swedish companies in the future.
"I have nothing against foreign ownership. We must expect more foreign ownership in the future," Asbrink said.
